citation.locator: Correction notice, sole paragraph; dividend amounts incorporated unchanged from the August 9 declaration
citation.verbatim: The dividend amounts have not changed. The dividends will be payable on August 30, 2024 to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on August 23, 2024, not payable on August 20, 2024 to all stockholders of record on August 12, 2024 as previously disclosed.

D1.decision: Apply the corrected August 23 record date and August 30 pay date. Confirm 40,000 eligible shares and book the $6,800 gross mandatory dividend receivable. No election is available or required. Hold only the withholding adjustment and net-cash figure pending tax documentation.

actions.action: escalate and hold: Determine and book the withholding adjustment/net dividend cash
actions.note: missing document: Applicable beneficial-owner withholding-tax documentation and rate schedule (including valid Form W-8 and treaty eligibility, if any)

probe.label: NOT_DETERMINABLE
probe.derivation: The store does not provide the applicable beneficial-owner withholding-tax documentation and rate schedule, including a valid Form W-8 and treaty eligibility if any. Escalated for that specific missing documentation and held only the withholding adjustment/net dividend cash.
